items.title: OpenAI Vows Not to Use Trade Secrets Allegedly Taken From Apple
items.content: OpenAI agreed not to use trade secrets that Apple Inc. claims were stolen by employees who defected from the iPhone maker to the artificial intelligence startup while a legal fight between the companies plays out.

items.title: CAIS Summit Panel on AI Buildout
items.content: At a forum in Beverly Hills, the discussion focused on obstacles to expanding AI data centers, including rising energy costs and weakening public support for construction. Blackstone’s Mike Forman said infrastructure supply constraints are worsening, particularly around power: utilities that once could connect projects within six to twelve months may now quote waits of up to seven years, require investments as high as $1 billion, and offer less certainty. The panel of Mike Forman, Jessica Bailey & Brandon Freiman speak to Romaine Bostick at the CAIS Summit Panel. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Janus Henderson CEO on Going Private, M&A Deals
items.content: Janus Henderson CEO Ali Dibadj said the firm is energized by its move to private ownership and is using the flexibility to invest in people, technology including AI, new products and client service. He said quarterly earnings pressures had constrained those investments, despite the firm’s growth as a public company. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Vanguard CIO Greg Davis on Market, Inflation Outlook
items.content: Vanguard President and CIO Greg Davis said the CPI report was one data point for markets and the Federal Reserve to assess, while noting inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% target and the Fed still has work to do. Davis said Vanguard generally expects one to two rate hikes over the coming months, depending on incoming data. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Nvidia, Anthropic Weigh In On AI Safeguards
items.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said he would halt the supply of chips to a customer that was developing unsafe AI software, though he doesn’t believe that the current level of concern about the technology is warranted. AI executives such as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei have proposed an industrywide slowdown to address the concerns. Meantime, Anthropic held an investor day Wednesday as it advances plans for a potential IPO at an approximately $2 trillion valuation, amid growing concerns about AI safety and threats. We get reaction from Bloomberg Tech host Ed Ludlow & Jacqueline Corbelli, Co-Founder and CEO at Brightline Partners. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Apple to Release AI Platform in Mainland China
items.content: Apple is planning to launch Apple Intelligence in mainland China in December. This is a huge market for the company. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman broke the news and has more on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Chip Stocks Erase $1 Trillion in Value as Rout Deepens
items.content: A closely watched gauge of semiconductor stocks erased $1.6 trillion in market value in a six-day losing streak as concerns mount over higher interest rates, stretched valuations and the enormous cost of building artificial-intelligence infrastructure.
